player_0.content: New plan: I prematurely concluded the exploration by issuing "DONE" while in the Attic, which still had an unvisited direction (west) available. My mistake was failing to verify that all reachable directions from the current room and all previously visited rooms had been fully explored before stopping. Next time, I will only issue "DONE" when the current room has no available directions AND I have confirmed that all other visited rooms have no untried directions leading to new nodes. Specifically, upon returning to the Attic, I should have checked the available directions, seen "west", and executed "GO: west" to explore the final room, rather than assuming the map was complete. I will also ensure the graph is updated with every new edge discovered before making a final decision.
